run_aloha_agent_streaming: run the Aloha agent in streaming mode using the run_for_duration_agent with default settings
run_aloha_agent_non_streaming: run the Aloha agent in non-streaming mode by passing use_streaming=False to the run_for_duration_agent
run_simple_aloha_agent: run the simple Aloha agent by passing simple_agent as the agent_name flag
create_agent_framework: create an AgentFramework instance with an EventBus, config, and agent instance to orchestrate agent execution
run_agent_with_sigint_handling: run the agent framework asynchronously with keyboard interrupt handling to gracefully cancel the main task
